name: Share Girl House ~Minna ni Share Sareta Boku no Kanojo~
original_name: シェアガールハウス ～皆にシェアされた僕の彼女～
source:
This is an NTR/cuckoldry-themed ADV where the protagonist's girlfriend is 'shared' by people in a sharehouse. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE241969.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款以NTR／寝取为主题的ADV，主人公的女友被合租房里的人“共享”。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE241969.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
